sources.entry: Gitbar - Open-source，display GitHub contribution statistics on your menu bar. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon] ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]](https://github.com/Shikkic/gitbar)

summary.one_liner: Gitbar is a BitBar plugin that shows a Mac menu bar summary of your public GitHub contribution stats, streaks, and optional contribution goals.
summary.what_it_does: Gitbar is a plugin for BitBar that displays a user's public GitHub contribution statistics in the macOS menu bar. It shows daily stats and streaks. The user can set a contribution goal and see a completion percentage toward it. Configuration is done through a .env file that holds the GitHub username, goal tracking on or off, the goal number, and a compact UI flag. The README says it gathers data by crawling public GitHub profiles with the gh-scrape module rather than through the GitHub API, so no API key is needed. It only counts publicly available contributions. The README does not describe any other features.
use_cases: track public github contributions from the mac menu bar
build a daily open source contribution habit
set and monitor a yearly contribution goal
view github streaks without opening a browser
monitor github activity without an api key
how_to_run: git clone the gitbar plugin repository.
Inside the repo folder, run: npm install
Edit the .env file in the root folder with your GITHUB_USERNAME and goal settings.
Launch BitBar and select the gitbar_plugin folder as the Plugin Folder.
If Node path errors occur, edit the shebang in gh.5m.js using the output of: which -a node
notable: Scrapes public GitHub profiles instead of using the GitHub API, so no API key is required
Optional contribution goal tracking with a completion percentage
Runs as a BitBar plugin in the macOS menu bar
caveats: macOS only; the README states it requires Mac OS X Snow Leopard (10.6) or newer
Requires BitBar and Node.js/npm to be installed first
